integrity: The subgroup lists and containment relations are explicit. Both underlying automorphism groups are parametrized directly from generators, and the induced actions on the two leaf blocks are computed symbolically. A standalone checker independently enumerates proper subgroups for p=3,5 and induced permutation images for p=3,5,7.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to odd primes and does not cover groups of order eight.
The inclusion graph and the common induced permutation image still do not distinguish the two groups; the distinction uses the kernel of the natural automorphism action.
The highly relevant 2020 nilpotent-inclusion-graph article was inspected through its abstract and first-page material rather than its complete article text.
title: Symmetry loss in inclusion graphs of the two rank-two groups of order \(p^3\)
